text: Plant operations alert: Wacky Wheels Lexington (P_KY) lost production to a power failure. Production is stopped from 2027-03-24 through 2027-03-25 inclusive.
summary: E-08 is Plant outage. 6 production orders move (6 rescheduled, 0 transferred). 25 dealer notice(s) and 15 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked Plant P_KY → production orders scheduled 2027-03-24 through 2027-03-25 inclusive. 6 orders cannot build during the outage. The line restarts 2027-03-26. Rule 2 and rule 3. Placed 6 at the same plant and transferred 0. Rule 4: 25 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 15 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 0 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 1 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
